import { Segmented, Card } from "march/ui" // termometre: aynı sıcaklık üç birimde; kayan gösterge seçilen birime süzülür, sayı ve rengi birlikte değişir const celsius = 23 const units = { "°C": { value: celsius, color: "brand-orange" }, "°F": { value: Math.round(celsius * 9 / 5 + 32), color: "brand-purple" }, "K": { value: Math.round(celsius + 273.15), color: "brand-blue" }, } as const export function Thermometer() { let $unit = "°C" const $now = units[$unit as keyof typeof units] return
{$now.value} {$unit}
}

import { Segmented, Card, Badge } from "march/ui" import { list, grid, sun, calendar, columns } from "march/icons" // satış panelinin başlığı: dönem seçimi (yıllık görünüm planda kapalı, nedeni ipucunda) ve yalnız ikonlu liste / ızgara const periods = [ { value: "day", label: "Gün", icon: sun }, { value: "week", label: "Hafta", icon: calendar }, { value: "month", label: "Ay", icon: columns }, { value: "year", label: "Yıl", disabled: true, title: "Yıllık rapor Pro planda" }, ] const views = [{ value: "list", label: "", icon: list, title: "Liste" }, { value: "grid", label: "", icon: grid, title: "Izgara" }] const sales = { day: { total: "18.450 ₺", orders: 42, change: "+%6" }, week: { total: "126.900 ₺", orders: 311, change: "+%12" }, month: { total: "534.200 ₺", orders: 1288, change: "-%3" } } export function SalesReport() { let $period = "week" let $view = "list" const $now = sales[$period as keyof typeof sales] return }>
{$now.total} {$now.orders} sipariş {$now.change}
}

{props.title}
{props.children}
export function SegmentedLab() { let $view = "Hafta" let $theme = "light" let $plan = "monthly" let $changes = 0 let $touched = false return
$touched = true} /> Seçili: {$view}{$touched ? " · dokunuldu" : ""}
